observations.behavior: Adds GCP Cloud Monitoring support, including GCP-specific env vars, a new receiver, and sharding compatibility checks.
observations.code_quote: Google Cloud Monitoring cannot push OTLP by itself, so the agent polls it: when `GCP_PROJECT_ID` is set, the agent calls the Cloud Monitoring `timeSeries.list` API for the metric types you list and forwards the points to PostHog, in the same pipeline as any Prometheus scrape.
